summary_en: HYUGA PRIMARY CARE initiated a tender offer to acquire 646,928 shares (8.7% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) held by the M3 Group and CUC, following completion of an external tender offer that resulted in 52.03% ownership for the acquirer JG44.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Commencement of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, HYUGA PRIMARY CARE's board of directors resolved to commence a tender offer to acquire 646,928 treasury shares (8.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) held by the M3 Group (M3 Inc., M3 Career Inc.) and CUC Co., Ltd. This tender offer represents the second stage of a broader transaction aimed at taking the company private.

The tender offer follows the successful completion of an external tender offer by JG44, a specially established acquisition vehicle backed by Japan Growth Investment Alliance (JGIA). That external offer resulted in 3,864,488 shares (52.03% ownership) being tendered, meeting the minimum threshold and allowing JG44 to become the parent company and principal shareholder. The company's board determined that the closing date of the external tender offer on November 17, 2026, satisfied the conditions precedent for commencing the company's own tender offer for the M3 Group and CUC shares.

As of September 30, 2026, the M3 Group held 2,040,000 shares (27.47% ownership) and held warrants convertible into additional shares. The acquisition of the 646,928 shares targeted in this tender offer forms part of the broader going-private transaction being orchestrated by the JGIA-backed acquirer.
